contractor.label: Contractor
contractor.text:
1. Standard installation labour: RM 250 per unit.
2. Extra copper piping: RM 150 per 3m set.
3. Quote from the price list. Prices are subject to stock availability and valid 7 days.

software.label: Software / agency
software.text:
1. Modules use the price-list annual licence price.
2. Custom features and change requests: RM 600 per developer day.
3. Quotes are valid 7 days.

wholesale.label: Wholesale / F&B
wholesale.text:
1. Wholesale items use the price-list carton or bag price.
2. Cold-chain delivery: RM 50 per trip, free above RM 1,500.
3. Urgent same-day lorry: add RM 120. Prices are subject to stock availability.

custom_retail.label: Custom shop
custom_retail.text:
1. Assembly or setup: RM 80 flat per order.
2. Upgrades and extra parts at price-list prices.
3. Quotes are valid 7 days. Prices are subject to stock availability.
